Statement: Staging models (schema stg) are owned by the data-engineering team; specifically stg_events and stg_users are tagged data_eng_owned in the dbt project.
Marts models (schema mart) are owned by the analytics-engineering team; specifically fct_user_activity and dim_user are tagged ae_owned in the dbt project.
Reference-data lookup tables are materialised into the ref schema via dbt seeds; the dbt config does not assign an owner tag to the seed block.
Notes: Direct config observation about what the config does AND does not declare

Statement: The BI team consumes the marts layer but is not formally assigned ownership of any dbt model.
JustificationRationale: Derived from AE's verbatim statement in E-006 (single-stakeholder attestation). Corroborated by the absence of BI-owned tags in the dbt config (cross-check against E-001+E-002 which list only data_eng_owned and ae_owned tags); contradicting source would require a separate BI-role attestation — routed to A51-002 for triangulation.
Notes: Inference; single T4 source pending T1-T3 corroboration

Statement: Approximately 30% of dashboard incidents trace back to upstream lineage changes that the downstream team (analytics engineering) was not notified of.
JustificationRationale: Derived from AE's rough estimate in E-005 (AE explicitly flagged the number as approximate). Exact-number assertion routed to A51-001 for validation against an incident-tracker export before promotion to any SLA commitment.

Statement: No team is formally designated as custodian of the reference-data (ref schema) tables; multiple teams update the tables without ownership attribution.
JustificationRationale: Derived from AE's verbatim statement in E-007 (single stakeholder) and corroborated by the absence of an owner tag on the seeds.reference_data block in dbt config (E-003). Contradicts the ae_owned and data_eng_owned tagging convention applied elsewhere.
Notes: Inference; supported by both T4 attestation and structural absence in T2 config

Statement: Recommend establishing an explicit reference-data custodian role (proposed owner: analytics engineering with quarterly rotation to data engineering) before expanding the dbt project to additional seed sets.
JustificationRationale: Analyst-judgment recommendation derived from the custodian-gap pain point (C-006) and the absence of an owner-tag convention in the existing dbt config for seeds (C-003). Requires stakeholder validation on proposed rotation cadence (A51-003).
